{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'loyal' not found in customer_segment"
assert df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "converted must be only 0 or 1"

# Check that only 'completed' orders count as conversions
# The documentation says: 'converted' is 1 if the order completed checkout
# So we rely on the 'converted' column directly

# Focus on loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction of loyal customers who converted
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_count / n_loyal

# Print result
print(fraction_converted)"}
